# The Islamabad Accords

> An unofficial peace plan for ending the US-Iran war and building a new security architecture for the Middle East: a ceasefire and three deals, an armistice (the All-Fronts Hudna), then five regionally owned institutions. A private author's proposal, made with AI assistance (the plan has its own AI disclosure). Licensed CC BY 4.0.

The site's slideshows hold their text in the page, but the plain-text edition is the best single source for reading, quoting or summarizing the plan: it has every card, page and deck-only slide in order, with sources.

## The plan

- [The complete plan in plain text](https://dhanna11.github.io/islamabad-accords/islamabad-accords.md): Markdown, every card and slide, with sources
- [Web edition](https://dhanna11.github.io/islamabad-accords/web.html): the same text as the PDF, with clickable source links

## Slideshows

- [Pitch](https://dhanna11.github.io/islamabad-accords/): the short version, the site's front page
- [Full deck](https://dhanna11.github.io/islamabad-accords/full.html): every slide, including the limits, objections and sources
- [One page](https://dhanna11.github.io/islamabad-accords/one-page.html): the whole plan on one slide

## PDFs

- [Full plan](https://dhanna11.github.io/islamabad-accords/islamabad-accords.pdf): the print edition
